newsitem.headline: HCIA Q4 net shr profit nil vs loss $0.62.

text.p: (In thousands, except per share data; unaudited)
Three months ended Year ended
December 31, December 31,
Net income (loss) per share 0.00 (0.62) (4.19) (0.31)
Shares used in per share calculation
Note: HCIA Inc recorded a one-time charge of $2.2 million
in the fourth quarter for the acquisition of in-process
research and development associated with the acquisition of
HealthChex Inc. Without such charges, net income per share
would have been $0.19 and $0.68 for the three and 12 months
ended Dec 31, 1996, respectively, against $0.18 and $0.60 for
the three and 12 months ending Dec 31, 1995, respectively.
The company recorded a one-time charge of $41.5 million in
the third quarter for acquisition of in-process research and
development associated with the purchase of LBA Health Care
Management Inc, and a one-time charge of $4.4 million in the
second quarter for acquisition of in-process research and development associated with the purchase of Response
Healthcare Information Management Inc.
